name: foldcrumbs evolving-state mini-bench
inspired_by: StateMemBench (arXiv 2608.19652) — closed-pool grading of whether a memory system serves the CURRENT state or a superseded one. Their dataset is not public; this is our own smaller, fully reproducible version. No LLM calls: deterministic stdlib-only, runs in CI time.

grading.CURRENT: the served context reflects the current state
grading.SUPERSEDED: the served context leads with an obsolete state
grading.FAIL: neither — the query served nothing usable

scenarios.desc: a decision is superseded by a newer one; recall must serve the NEW text and must not lead with the old
